reason: A browser-side UI companion that adds a persistent animated pixel whale to the conversation header and reacts visually to session activity and clicks without changing model requests or tool schemas.

summaries.zh: 在会话标题栏中添加常驻的手绘像素鲸鱼，并根据会话状态展示动画与点击互动。
summaries.en: Adds a persistent hand-drawn pixel whale to the conversation header with animations driven by session activity and click interaction.

capabilities: Renders a persistent pixel-art whale in the session header
Displays browser-side animations based on conversation session state
Responds to clicks with a visual heart animation
